title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Empresa está contratando Global ta manager (contractor role) em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location:Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration:6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation:Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!)Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only:Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground.What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery:Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation:Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency:Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast.The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese):Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages.You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine:2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility:Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset.Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine:You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails:You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack.What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential:On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook:Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew:No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination:Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity:Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) full stack sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor(a) full stack sênior em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Volpi Esqueça a burocracia dos bancões: a Volpi é a fintech que resolve.Simplificamos o financiamento imobiliário para deixar tudo 100% digital e infinitas vezes mais rápido. Trazemos décadas de experiência para transformar processos complexos em soluções ágeis, antecipando problemas e soluções. Tornamos a análise de crédito inteligente, feita sob medida para cada história. Com tecnologia proprietária construímos a solução completa, guiada por especialistasO desafio Estamos buscando uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior com forte experiência em Angular e Python para se juntar ao nosso time de Engenharia. Aqui,você vai atuar de ponta a ponta no desenvolvimento de aplicações críticas para o negócio-desde a experiência no frontend até arquitetura, backend, infraestrutura e deploys em produção.Mais do que apenas desenvolver features, buscamos alguém que goste de resolver problemas complexos, tomar decisões técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da nossa arquitetura e engenharia.Você fará parte de um ambiente cloud-native na AWS, com cultura forte de ownership, colaboração e entregas contínuas, trabalhando em produtos com alto impacto real no negócio e bastante espaço para influência técnica.O que você vai fazer Projetar, desenvolver e manter aplicações web escaláveis utilizando Angular no frontend e Python no backend Definir arquitetura de soluções, propor padrões técnicos e participar ativamente de decisões de design de sistemas Implementar e evoluir APIs RESTful (e/ou Graph QL), garantindo performance, segurança e escalabilidade Construir e manter pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando build, testes e deploy. Provisionar e operar recursos na AWS, aplicando boas práticas de cloud, observabilidade e custo Escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado, com cobertura adequada de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e) Realizar code reviews construtivas e atuar como referência técnica para pessoas desenvolvedoras pleno e júnior Colaborar com Product, Design e demais squads em cerimônias ágeis, contribuindo para refinamento, estimativas e planejamento Identificar gargalos de performance e propor melhorias contínuas em aplicações e processosO que esperamos de você +8 anos de experiênciaem desenvolvimento de software, com atuação consolidada como Full Stack Sólidoconhecimento em Front-end Usar Claude Codecomo assistente de desenvolvimento, somo uma empresa AI-Native e usamos AI no core de nossas aplicações para facilitar o dia-a-dia Experiência sólida com Angular(versões 14+), Type Script, Rx JS, Ng Rx ou abordagens equivalentes de gerenciamento de estado Domínio de Pythonem contexto de aplicações web, com frameworks como Fast API, Django ou Flask Experiência prática com CI/CD(Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins, Circle CI ou similares) Vivência com AWSe seus principais serviços: EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, ECS/EKS, Cloud Watch, IAM, API Gateway Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL, My SQL) e noções de No SQL (Dynamo DB, Mongo DB ou Redis) Experiência com containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes ou ECS) Versionamento com Git e fluxos de trabalho colaborativos (Git Flow, trunk-based) Práticas de testes automatizados, TDD e code review Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e comunicação escritaDiferenciais Experiência com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Cloud Formation ou AWS CDK) Vivência com arquiteturas de microsserviços e mensageria (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Rabbit MQ) Conhecimento em observabilidade (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK) Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times maduros Contribuições para projetos open source ou comunidade técnica Certificações AWS (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect)Como é trabalhar na Volpi: Na Volpi, vivemos nossos princípios todos os dias: Inconformismo & Protagonismo:Assumimos a responsabilidade em cada detalhe e buscamos incansavelmente evoluir em tudo que fazemos Colaboração: Construímos juntos:todos são bem-vindos a levantar a mão e contribuir, expertise e informação são mais valiosos que cargos Eficiência radical:Executamos com foco e agilidade, usando tecnologia e expertise para reduzir riscos e eliminar gargalosBenefícios que oferecemos: 100% remoto — trabalhe de onde você quiser, no mundo Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes) R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação ️ 30 dias de descanso remunerado por ano + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano Day off no aniversário Total Pass (incluindo Total Mind) Acesso ao Wework Encontro presencial 1x por ano, muita troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Customer success manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer success manager em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Employment Type:Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B)About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You’ll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Project manager em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development. About Ten16 CreativeTen16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership. We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces. About the RoleThe Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work. This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving. You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth. You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving. You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send. Qualifications

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Global ta manager (contractor role) em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!
